Walkthrough: minisvc for new admins (fixture transcript)

Speaker A: So minisvc is the little status service. You install it with make install, that's the whole setup.
Speaker A: Then you run make status and it should say ok.
Speaker B: Which port does it listen on?
Speaker A: The API is on the port from the config file. And there is an admin UI on port 7070, you can open it in the browser after the install.
Speaker B: Is the admin UI on by default?
Speaker A: Yes, it comes up with the service.
Speaker B: And it only listens on localhost?
Speaker A: Right, it binds to 127.0.0.1, so you need to be on the host.
